arm_definitions.seeded_random: BLAKE2b seeded candidate order, reseeded per task from base seed and task ID; fixed, zero fit CPU.
arm_definitions.streaming: policy=None probe order with lazy descriptors; no ranking features, zero fit CPU.
arm_definitions.trained_mlp: 12-to-16 ReLU-to-1, 225 parameters, same capped groups and margin loss as v2, Adam lr=0.05, 40 epochs; fit CPU charged.
arm_definitions.trained_recurrent: 12-to-16 input and 16-to-16 tanh recurrence, six ticks from zero per drive, averaged readout; same groups/loss/optimizer/epochs; fit CPU charged.
arm_definitions.untrained_mlp: Same 12-to-16 ReLU-to-1 architecture as trained_mlp with its initialization seed and no fitting; zero fit CPU.

claim_scope: Only this frozen corpus, arms, budgets and recorded environment. A pass supports further investigation of learned ranking, not unrestricted generalization, SNN claims, or energy claims.

corpus.derivation: Same enumerator and selection code path as benchmark-pre-eval-v2 (rsi_programmer/benchmark_v2_corpus.py) with fresh family seeds {repeated_subtree: 83071, balanced: 83072, skewed: 83073}, split seed 83074 and input seed 83075. The 102 exact integer-polynomial functions already banked in v1/v2 were removed from eligibility before selection and recorded as prior_bank_functions; selection quotas and rules are otherwise unchanged.
corpus.difficulty_floor: Require degree>=2 and (degree>=5 or degree==4 and coefficient L1>1 or degree==3 and L1>2 or degree==2 and L1>4).
split_guarantees: 72 globally distinct canonical integer polynomial functions across train and eval
zero exact function overlap with v1 and v2 (runner re-verifies at load)
unique witness syntax and task IDs
globally disjoint observed and held coordinate pairs
selection uses syntax, exact algebra, fixed seeds and quotas only; no solver, ranker or runtime outcome filtering

cost.amortization_note: Fit CPU is charged once per seed and amortized as fit_cpu/48 added to each of that seed's 48 eval cells. The declared volume is the actual evaluation volume (48 tasks x 3 seeds = 144 cells), not a hypothetical deployment volume. Both unamortized totals and amortized charged totals are reported.
cost.cell_budget_note: Identical per arm per cell, enforced by a process CPU timer (ITIMER_VIRTUAL); over-budget cells are recorded as cpu-budget-exceeded failures, never retried. 10.0 s is ~17x the slowest pre-freeze probe cell (0.57 s, median 0.12 s), so it binds only pathological cells.
cost.fit_accounting: CostClock CPU seconds around fit_with_work for each learned arm and seed; 0.0 for fixed arms.

decision_rule.equal_cpu_method: Per seed, order cells in frozen task order, accumulate charged CPU (search CPU plus amortized fit share), and truncate the higher-total arm at the lower arm's total; compare accepted fractions. Average over seeds.
decision_rule.slow_win_rule: A learned arm that solves more only with more than 2x streaming's total charged CPU also closes the line.
decision_rule.verbatim_kill: at equal total CPU the learned ranker solves no more than streaming/heuristic, or its solve advantage needs more than 2x streaming's time => close line

evaluation.acceptance: Exactly one search attempt per cell using only twelve observed rows, common bound five, oracle=None. Independently validate any returned graph on observed and held rows, then canonicalize the returned graph polynomial and require equality to the frozen expected polynomial.
evaluation.budget_unit: cpu_seconds (identical per arm per cell); candidate_backstop is a non-binding safety net only
evaluation.run_matrix: 3 seeds x 48 tasks x 6 arms: 864 rows, including every failure and budget-exceeded censoring event

feature_encoding.definition: Operator one-hot (3); left/right/root tree sizes divided by common bound (3); operand hit and inside fractions against observed targets (4); original generation ordinal divided by full layer width and its complement (2). No candidate output, exact-match flag, witness, canonical function, held row or evaluation-task feature participates in fitting.
feature_encoding.name: layer-ordinal-v1

provenance.freeze: Protocol, corpus and generator hashes pinned here and in rsi_programmer/cpu_matched_frozen.py before any full-matrix measurement. The runner rejects any byte drift.
provenance.snn_exclusion: No SNN arm by owner direction (Drop: SNN-specific advantage claims everywhere). Untrained_mlp is the untrained control.

training.loss: Sum of per-group mean softplus(1 - (positive score - negative score)); one optimizer update per epoch for eligible groups.
